notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
--top-ports N scans only the N most commonly open ports based on Nmap's frequency database. Useful for rapid initial discovery across many hosts — trade thoroughness for speed.

=== WORKFLOW INTEGRATION ===
Quick top-10/top-100 scan for rapid alive host + service identification → feed interesting hosts to full -p- scan. Top-ports scan gives immediate actionable results while comprehensive scan runs in background.

=== PORT FREQUENCY ===
Nmap's port frequency database is based on real-world scan data. Top 10: 21, 22, 23, 25, 80, 110, 139, 443, 445, 3389. Top 100 catches the vast majority of common services.
